rounds.comment: Kenny, 2026-10-20: 17 of 22 approved, 5 not approved. Fixed directly after the review (no second round): he judges the fixes in the real app. Each not-approved entry names the fixing commit.

notApproved.note: Approved, make sure that the timer is configurable, make the default 30 seconds
notApproved.fix: the clear delay is any duration (data-kp-secret-clear, option clearAfterMs), default 30 s, 0/off/never disables

notApproved.note: when pressing rule, it sorts on rule, another press and it sorts backwards, when I click again it should remove the sort, now it goes back and sorts normal again. It's not possible to unsort.
notApproved.fix: a header press goes ascending, descending, unsorted (sortCycle 'three' is the default; Shift press drops the key on its third press)

notApproved.note: we should also be able to change to minutes and hours and days, weeks etc … I wanted my components configurable, with a component that deals with time, I obviously want all sorts of time options
notApproved.fix: timeUnit takes ms, s, min, h, d, w (months and years left out: their length varies)

notApproved.note: clicking a link in the left box doesn't scroll to the item in the right box yet
notApproved.fix: a press or Enter scrolls the pane that holds the sections (found by itself, own copy first), focus to the heading, scroll-spy follows the pane

notApproved.note: this needs the same loading icon in the centre as we do for tables. The (skeleton?) lines are ugly in this element
notApproved.fix: the gate loads with the busy card of a loading table over its full footprint, skeleton lines removed
